title_en: Fall 2026 Master's and Doctoral Thesis Review Public Presentation Schedule (Subject to Change)
summary: The schedules for the Fall 2026 master's thesis review public presentations and doctoral preliminary review (초심) public presentations are provided only in the two attached PDF files, which were not read for this translation. Attendees, including students enrolled in the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나), must check the attached files again on the day of each review, because times, rooms and other details may change at any time. Questions should go to the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
applies_to: All attendees of the Fall 2026 master's and doctoral thesis review public presentations, including students enrolled in the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나); these attendees must check the attached schedule on the day of the review. The notice does not state that attendance itself is mandatory or for whom.

dates.what: Checking the attached schedule for the latest time and room (all attendees, including Master's/Doctoral Seminar students)
dates.when: On the day of each review, before attending

conditions: The presentation dates, times and rooms are only in the attached PDF files, which were not read for this translation.
The schedule may change at any time without separate notice, including times and rooms.
Checking the attachment only once in advance is not enough; attendees must check it again on the day of the review.
steps: Open the attachment "2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf" (master's review schedule) or "2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf" (doctoral preliminary review schedule) on this notice and find the presentations you will attend.
On the day of the review, open the attached file again on this notice to confirm the current time and room before attending.
Direct any questions to the department office in Building 301, Room 319; contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Subject to change) Fall 2026 Master's/Doctoral Thesis Review Public Presentation Schedule

We announce the schedule of the Fall 2026 master's/doctoral thesis review public presentations.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- See the attached file (contents may change at any time).

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary review [초심]) schedule
- See the attached file (contents may change at any time).

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached files) is updated at any time. Because times, rooms and other details may change, attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar [석박사세미나], must check the attached file again on the day of the review.

4. Inquiries
- Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person, phone number and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2):
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 doctoral preliminary review schedule, 201 KB)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 master's review schedule, 300 KB)

[Note: The attached files were not read; the schedule details they contain are not included in this translation.]
